title: Loops: for and while read
summary: Repeat a command for each file, or for each line of a file.

text: for takes each item of a list in turn. Here the list comes from *.jpg.
- Inside, $f is the current item: quote it, names can have spaces.

scheme: for i in {1..3}; do echo "try $i"; done
text: - {1..3} counts for you. seq 1 3 does the same.
- On one line, ; separates the parts.

scheme: └─ one line at a time into $host
text: while read handles a file line by line, even long files.
- Don't use for line in $(cat file): it cuts at every space, not only at line ends.
